title: Fix two data-loss bugs in persistent projects: unawaited unload flush + Save-As autosave race
description: Audit of the persistent-projects feature (task 1310) found TWO high-confidence DATA-LOSS bugs in packages/authoring-ui/src/projects/. Fix both (the whole feature exists to NOT lose work). BUG 1 (unload durability) — useProjectActions.ts ~202: the pagehide/visibilitychange handler calls autosaveRef.current?.flush() with  (fire-and-forget); IndexedDB writes are async so the final autosave can be lost when the tab closes/reloads before the transaction commits. FIX: make the last-chance flush as durable as practical — prefer flushing on visibilitychange->'hidden' (fires while the page is still alive, the recommended lifecycle point) and START the IndexedDB write synchronously in the handler; keep pagehide as a backstop; minimize the unsaved window (e.g. proactive flush on blur/idle). IndexedDB can't be fully awaited during unload — implement the best-practice durable path and DOCUMENT the residual best-effort nature; do not claim impossible guarantees. BUG 2 (Save-As race, silent overwrite) — autosaveController.ts ~142 + useProjectActions.ts persist closure ~111-120 + activeNameRef assignment ~226: the autosave persist callback reads activeNameRef.current at RESOLVE time, so if the user does Save As during the autosave debounce window, a stale in-flight autosave (old bytes) writes over the newly-saved named slot. FIX: lock the target slot to the bytes at the moment autosave decides to save (capture {bytes/doc, targetSlot} together at schedule/serialize/fire time, not at await-resolution), AND supersede any pending/in-flight autosave when an explicit Save/Save As runs (bump the generation so a stale autosave can't write). Consider a monotonic per-slot version/timestamp in IndexedDB rejecting older writes as defense-in-depth. VERIFY: build + authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable). Add regression tests: (a) Save As fired during a pending autosave debounce does NOT get overwritten by the stale autosave (the named slot ends with the Save-As bytes); (b) the unload/visibility flush path writes the latest bytes (assert the durable-write path is invoked synchronously with current bytes; use fake-indexeddb + fake timers). Don't regress existing project tests/e2e. Update docs/35-persistent-projects.md (durability semantics). ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry (if .tasks/.counter conflicts keep origin's). Scope: projects/autosaveController.ts + useProjectActions.ts (+ projectStore version guard if you add one) + tests.
